note: SEED opens on the refrain bell

text:
This is peaceful, this is excellent, namely the stilling of all
preparations, the relinquishment of all assets, the destruction of
craving, detachment, cessation, extinction.
plain: This is peaceful, this is excellent, namely, everything the mind makes comes to a stop, the letting go of everything carried, the wanting ends, nothing pulls you any more, stopping, going out, like a flame with no fuel.

say: Why don't I see Nibbana right now?

text:
The basic principle underlying this whirlpool is to be found in our
bodies. What we call 'breathing' is a continuous process of emptying and
filling up. So even the so-called 'life-principle' is not much different
from the activity of a whirlpool. The functioning of the lungs and the
heart is based on the same principle and the blood circulation is in fact
a whirling round.
plain: The basic principle underlying this whirlpool is to be found in our bodies. What we call 'breathing' is a continuous process of emptying and filling up. So even the so-called 'life-principle' is not much different from the activity of a whirlpool. The functioning of the lungs and the heart is based on the same principle and the blood circulation is in fact a whirling round.

text:
Impelled by that imagining, it runs towards the mirage... The gap is
ignored... What impels one to ignore that gap is craving.
plain: Impelled by that making it into something, it runs towards the mirage... The gap is ignored... What impels one to ignore that gap is craving.

say: How is the sense of self constructed?

text:
The boys scatter them with their hands and feet, demolish them,
dismantle them and render them unplayable. Even so, Rādha, you all
scatter form, feeling, perception, preparations, consciousness.
Practise for the destruction of craving.
plain: The boys scatter them with their hands and feet, demolish them, dismantle them and render them unplayable. Even so, Radha, you all scatter form, pleasant-or-unpleasant tone, perception, things the mind makes, consciousness. Practise for the wanting ends.

text: In the seen there will be just the seen... Then you will not be by it. And when you are not by it, you are not in it. And when you are not in it, you are neither here nor there nor in between. This itself is the end of suffering.
plain: In the seen there will be just the seen... Then you will not be by it. And when you are not by it, you are not in it. And when you are not in it, you are neither here nor there nor in between. This itself is the end of suffering.

text: In short, he has seen the magic show so well as to miss the show.
plain: In short, he has seen the magic show so well as to miss the show.
